contents.text: Added specific Temperature for the Nether
Rebalanced Hydration for the Nether (a dry and unlively place which depletes your hydration bar in a matter of mere seconds)
Added Prismarine Armour which eliminates passive Hydration losses but drowns the player outside of the Nether
Reworked the balance between temperature and heat. Hopefully, the system is now more reliable and transparent
Added Prismarice, which can be smelted or blasted from seeds
Players now gain a bit of cooling when increasing their Hydration

Fixed Bugs:
Bonus Hydration cooling applies to fast due to an oversight
